letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still get butterflies thinking about our wedding on that golden February day, and each night I fall asleep grateful for your laughter that fills our home. You’re my cutie, my compass, the warm hug that steadies me wherever we are. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into unforgettable memories—I love you more than words can ever capture.
poem:
In sunrise gold or monsoon rain,  
Your smile makes my heart refrain.  
From desert dunes to city lights,  
With you, love, every day feels right.
